feature.name: Component discovery and saved-reference workspace
feature.objective: Find, filter, shortlist, compare and export verified public UI reference metadata offline without executing or republishing third-party code.
acceptance_criteria: Search 9,403 indexed references with source and type filters without regressing current search.
Group known style/implementation variants conservatively without deleting source entries.
Save up to 200 references in browser-local storage and export/import valid JSON safely.
Compare up to three entries side by side with upstream links, dependencies and metadata.
Mobile and desktop browsing remain usable and accessible; Node and Chromium tests pass.

source_of_truth.authority_rule: Preserve the repository's existing UI; other websites are reference data, never authoritative designs.

tokens.motion: Optional subtle CSS feedback; honors prefers-reduced-motion

design_system.contrast_review: CI plus manual visual review outstanding

interactions.success_condition: Saved list updated and export enabled
interactions.failure_condition: No data lost; warning explains storage/limit

interactions.success_condition: Up to three public metadata records shown
Known IDs restored or downloadable JSON created
interactions.failure_condition: Invalid upload leaves existing saved list unchanged
interactions.cancellation_or_undo: Export first; import a previously saved list

tool_runs.decisions: GitHub connector verified; no browser MCP or external component services required.
Results must be verified from GitHub Actions before merge.

quality_gates.security_review: no external scripts, import validation, textContent rendering, HTTPS links

decisions.reason: Third-party preview code may be proprietary or unsafe to execute.

decisions.decision: Use browser local storage and explicit JSON import/export without cloud account
Group only known React Bits and HyperUI variants

handoff.next_stage: run CI and confirm mobile/desktop regression coverage
